units.source_text: 我在这方面没有任何经验，虽然觉得怪吓人的，却笑了笑，

en.t: I had no experience with such things, and though it frightened me a little, I smiled,

units.source_text: 说：“反正是不治之症，再着急也没有用。”

en.t: and said, "In any case, it is an incurable illness, so there is no use getting anxious."

units.source_text: “要是能这样想得开，也就没什么可说的了。”

en.t: "If you can take it that way, then there is nothing more to be said."

units.source_text: 夫人大概想起了以前因患同样病症死去的母亲，低着头，声音低沉地说道。

en.t: The lady, probably remembering her mother who had died earlier of the same illness, lowered her head and spoke in a subdued voice.

units.source_text: 我也从心里为父亲的命运而伤感起来。

en.t: I too began to feel sad from the heart about my father's fate.

units.source_text: 这时，先生突然对夫人说：“静，你会死在我前头吗？”

en.t: Just then, Sensei suddenly said to his wife, "Shizu, will you die before I do?"

units.source_text: “为什么这么问？”

en.t: "Why do you ask that?"

units.source_text: “不为什么，只是问问。

en.t: "For no particular reason. I was only asking.

units.source_text: 要不就是我走在你前头吧。

en.t: Or perhaps I will be the one to go before you.

units.source_text: 世上大多是丈夫先死，妻子在后，这好像是一般规律呢。”

en.t: In the world, husbands usually die first and wives remain after them; that seems to be the general rule."

units.source_text: “也不是必然的。

en.t: "It is not necessarily so.

units.source_text: 不过，男人的岁数一般比女人大一些。”

en.t: But men are generally a little older than women."

units.source_text: “所以才会先死的嘛。

en.t: "That is why they die first, then.

units.source_text: 这么说，我也应该比你先一步去那个世界喽。”

en.t: In that case, I suppose I ought to go to the other world one step ahead of you."

units.source_text: “你和别人不一样。”

en.t: "You are different from other people."

units.source_text: “是吗？”

en.t: "Am I?"

units.source_text: “当然了。

en.t: "Of course.

units.source_text: 你身体这么结实，几乎没生过什么病。

en.t: You are so strong and have hardly ever been ill.

units.source_text: 不管怎么说，还是我在前。”

en.t: No matter how you look at it, I will still go first."

units.source_text: “你在前？”

en.t: "You first?"

units.source_text: “是啊，一定是我在前。”

en.t: "Yes, I am sure I will go first."

units.source_text: 先生瞧了瞧我，我笑了。

en.t: Sensei glanced at me, and I laughed.

units.source_text: “可是，如果我先走一步的话，你怎么办呢？”

en.t: "But if I were to go first, what would you do?"

units.source_text: “怎么办……”

en.t: "What would I do..."

units.source_text: 夫人语塞了。

en.t: The lady was at a loss for words.

units.source_text: 失去先生的悲哀想象，似乎袭上了她的心头。

en.t: The sad thought of losing Sensei seemed to come over her heart.

units.source_text: 但是，当她再度抬起头来时，心情已经调整过来了。

en.t: But when she raised her head again, she had already composed herself.

units.source_text: “怎么办？

en.t: "What would I do?

units.source_text: 没有办法的呀，你说是吧？

en.t: There would be nothing I could do, would there?

units.source_text: 所谓黄泉路上无老少啊！”

en.t: After all, they say that on the road to the underworld there is no old or young!"
